intro:
A decoration-focused café game where you bake and brew... TO 
THE BEAT!
description:
Have you ever wanted to escape from the stress of urban life? 
Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café is a cozy and relaxing decoration 
and rhythm game where you manage a café and befriend cute 
animals. 
 
■ Low stress, non confrontational, relaxing experience. 
■ Manage your own cafeteria Customize your place with 
furniture, decorations, lamps, wallpaper, and flooring. Take 
pictures of your favourite corners, dishes, and customers 
and share them on the café's website. 
■ Adorable customers Forge friendships and learn about 
their favourite recipes and decorations. 
■ Learn new recipes... To the beat! Prepare snacks and 
drinks, from waffles to sodas, to the rhythm of upbeat tunes 
and colourful animations. 
■ Unleash your creativity! Practice your skills whenever 
you like. Experiment with new ingredient combinations and 
sell them in your own vending machine to earn rewards! 
■ Use your own custom designs! You can customize 
different objects, as well as your dishes! Paint signs, 
posters and even T-shirts for your customers.
